title: She came to Canada from India at age four. In 2026, she was named one of its Top 25 immigrants.

sources.text: The Global Indian - Six Indian-born achievers among Canada's Top 25 immigrants of 2026
BusinessWire - 18th Annual Top 25 Canadian Immigrant Awards Presented by Western Union

caption:
She came to Canada from India at age four. In 2026, she was named one of its Top 25 immigrants.

Born in India, she moved to Toronto's Rexdale neighbourhood at age four. The 18th annual awards, presented by Western Union, are chosen through a judged process plus over 50,000 public votes.

She's built a career on both sides of the camera, bringing Punjabi and South Asian stories to mainstream Canadian television rather than only acting in others' projects.

Wraich's path - from India to Rexdale to Canadian primetime - is a reminder that cultural representation and creative ownership are part of what global Indian success looks like too.
